## Walkthrough

Updates lint-ignore comments in `assembly/interpreter.ts`, migrates `bin/fuzz.ts` to use `pvm_interpreter` with register decoding, bumps Biome schema and adds linter overrides, and updates package dependencies (`@biomejs/biome`, `@typeberry/lib`).

## Changes

| Cohort / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Lint comment cleanup** <br> `assembly/interpreter.ts` | Removed two `biome-ignore` lint comments preceding private members `argsRes` and `outcomeRes`; no runtime or API changes. |
| **Fuzzer register decoding** <br> `bin/fuzz.ts` | Replaced `pvm` import with `pvm_interpreter`; instantiate `pvm_interpreter.DebuggerAdapter`; added `REGISTER_BYTE_WIDTH` and `decodeRegisters()` to convert little-endian register bytes to `bigint[]`; use decoded `vmRegisters` for comparisons and output; validates buffer size. |
| **Linter configuration** <br> `biome.jsonc` | Bumped JSON schema from `2.3.6` to `2.3.8` and added an `overrides` block disabling `noPrecisionLoss` for `assembly/**/*.ts`. |
| **Dependency updates** <br> `package.json` | Bumped `@biomejs/biome` to `^2.3.8` and `@typeberry/lib` to `^0.5.0`. |

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes

- Review `bin/fuzz.ts` for correct little-endian -> bigint decoding and buffer-size validation in `decodeRegisters()`.
- Confirm `pvm_interpreter.DebuggerAdapter` usage matches expected API.
- Check `biome.jsonc` override scope to ensure it targets only intended assembly files.
